newsitem.title: UK: Harris poll shows UK Labour 17 points ahead.
newsitem.headline: Harris poll shows UK Labour 17 points ahead.

text.p: An opinion poll by Harris for the Independent newspaper showed the main opposition Labour Party 17 points ahead of the ruling Conservatives on the eve of Thursday's British election.
The poll showed Labour on 48 percent, Conservatives on 31 and the Liberal Democrats on 15 percent. Harris interviewed 1,154 adults between April 27 and 29.
Of the sample, 14 percent were don't knows, won't says or won't votes and were excluded from the figures.
